messages.subject_clean: Results column in updated wiki table
messages.body_plain:
Dear GSOC-R students,

If you have not already, please put your code in a public repository (GitHub, R-Forge, etc) and add a link to it under the Results column of
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2015/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects

Please do this before the mid-term deadline, Friday July 3 http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/events/google/gsoc2015 If you do not add a link to your code before the mid-term deadline we will be forced to fail your project.

Happy coding and have a nice day!
